lines: The warmth of the hearts we shared
I carried it gently, treasuring it as I walked
Inside a wish with no answer
Words changed the future
The dream I'd had since childhood still feels
Far away, but if you're with me
I feel I could grow a little stronger
So I layered on the colors of tomorrow
Following the hope I called out, I crossed the world I'd stopped
This longing that won't give up, before I knew it, connected our hearts
Even if I cry, I'll smile and go meet tomorrow
The vow I made—even if it's painful and I fall
It's to protect your heart
In the flow of time, beyond memory
Surely there was the warmth I'd been searching for
The moment it wrapped around me, all of
My longing turns toward you
Running toward the sky, I took hold of
So many precious lights, and tucked them in my chest
Turning them into the radiance inside me
Sweeping all my doubts away, I'll fly
Through a tangled maze where no answer can be seen
The tears you shed woke my heart
And I learned the world is still this beautiful
It will give birth to new possibilities
From the wish in a fragment of time
I saved it, believed in the longing that shattered
I'll stand at the beginning
And win back your smile
Becoming a miracle of truth
Following the hope I called out, I crossed the world I'd stopped
This longing that won't give up, before I knew it, connected our hearts
Even if I cry, I'll smile and go meet tomorrow
The vow I made—even if it's painful and I fall
It's to protect your heart
I'll stay by your side
